'''Tubeworms''' were one of the many creatures that lived in the warm waters of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. Tubeworms also lived on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
